payload.purpose_context: This mission advances sqlite postgresql support on main so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.

payload.wp_title: Typed persistence proof and real database harness
Dialect schemas, configuration and adapter lifecycle
Versioned migrations, legacy adoption and readiness
Periods, tasks, timers, tags and metrics persistence
Complete parity, upgrades and recovery evidence
Production image, migration command and local deployment
Required CI matrix and trusted GHCR publication
Operating documentation and CNPG deployment handoff
Portable version-2 backup and atomic restore
Social, queries, plugins, AI and application cutover
